description: This PHP class 'PerformanceTrackerLogDecorator' provides a wrapper around the PerformanceTrackerLog entity, providing methods to access and modify related data such as adding dates, modified dates, reviewer, user, and performance tracker references within the HRM system.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing convenient methods to access and modify PerformanceTrackerLog entity data, including date formatting and setting related employee, user, and tracker references.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a PerformanceTrackerLog entity.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted added date of the performance tracker log, or null if not available.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted modified date of the performance tracker log, or null if not available.

methods.name: setReviewerByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee reviewer based on their employee number.

methods.name: setUserByUserId
methods.description: Sets the user related to the performance tracker log based on user ID.

methods.name: setPerformanceTrackerById
methods.description: Associates a performance tracker with the log using its ID.
